findings.text: Requested effective date was changed from 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-01 without any quoted supporting evidence in the fix event. The source form explicitly shows 2026-12-01, and seq 6002 provides empty evidence for overriding it.

Election type was changed from OEP to AEP based on a rule/diagnosis rather than quoted evidence from the source document. The cited evidence at seq 6001 quotes the form as 'Election: OEP', which supports the original value, not the changed value AEP.
